records.jp: ただいまー！
records.en_original: We're back!
records.en_auxiliary: We're back!
records.en: We're back!

records.jp: ふう……。なんか、どっと疲れた……
records.en_original: Phew... I'm feeling tired all of a sudden.
records.en_auxiliary: Phew... I'm feeling tired all of a sudden.
records.en: Phew... I'm feeling tired all of a sudden.

records.jp: 一番疲れたのはこころでしょ！
records.en_original: I bet Kokoro has it the worst!
records.en_auxiliary: I bet Kokoro has it the worst!
records.en: I bet Kokoro has it the worst!

records.jp: わたしは……うん、ちょっと疲れたかな
records.en_original: I am a little tired...
records.en_auxiliary: I am a little tired...
records.en: I am a little tired...

records.jp: そりゃ疲れるよ。いきなりあんなもの見たらね
records.en_original: Not surprising, going through what you did.
records.en_auxiliary: Not surprising, going through what you did.
records.en: Of course you're tired after suddenly seeing something like that.

records.jp: 不思議な場所だったね……
records.en_original: What a strange place...
records.en_auxiliary: What a strange place...
records.en: What a strange place...

records.jp: 人の想い……心を核に作られた小さな世界
records.en_original: A little world created from people's feelings...
records.en_auxiliary: A little world created from people's feelings...
records.en: A small world created around a person's feelings... their heart.

records.jp: まるで一種のビオトープのよう
records.en_original: Like it's created from their heart itself.
records.en_auxiliary: Like it's created from their heart itself.
records.en: It's like a kind of biotope.

records.jp: ……そういえば、リフナビが気になることを言ってた。<CR>いろんな世界に行ってもらった方が良いかもねって
records.en_original: Something ReSource said has been bothering me... It said that we should go to lots of different worlds, right?
records.en_auxiliary: Something ReSource said has been bothering me... It said that we should go to lots of different worlds, right?
records.en: Come to think of it, ReSource said something that bothered me.<CR>That maybe it would be better for us to visit all sorts of worlds.

records.jp: もしかして、ここ以外にも“向こうの世界”が<CR>あるってこと？
records.en_original: Which means there are more worlds than the Faraway?
records.en_auxiliary: Which means there are more worlds than the Faraway?
records.en: Could that mean there are other Faraways<CR>besides this one?

records.jp: もしそうだとしたら……他の世界には、<CR>伶那ちゃんや勇希ちゃんの記憶もあるのかな？
records.en_original: Maybe there are worlds with Rena and Yuki's memories.
records.en_auxiliary: Maybe there are worlds with Rena and Yuki's memories.
records.en: If so... could the other worlds hold<CR>Rena-chan's and Yuki-chan's memories too?

records.jp: かもしれない
records.en_original: It's possible.
records.en_auxiliary: It's possible.
records.en: It's possible.

records.jp: ねね、そしたらさ。<CR>名前つけようよ。名前
records.en_original: If that's the case, we need to give it another name.
records.en_auxiliary: If that's the case, we need to give it another name.
records.en: Hey, if that's true,<CR>let's give them names. Names!

records.jp: え？
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: だってさ、どれもこれも“向こうの世界”って<CR>言うわけにはいかないじゃん？
records.en_original: I don't think what we have now works very well anymore.
records.en_auxiliary: I don't think what we have now works very well anymore.
records.en: We can't call every one of them 'the Faraway,'<CR>can we?

records.jp: 別に名前なんてどうでもいいでしょ
records.en_original: Who cares what it's called.
records.en_auxiliary: Who cares what it's called.
records.en: Who cares what it's called.

records.jp: そんなことないよ！<CR>こういうのは雰囲気が大事なんだから！
records.en_original: Hey! Setting the mood for this kind of thing is super important!
records.en_auxiliary: Hey! Setting the mood for this kind of thing is super important!
records.en: That's not true!<CR>The atmosphere matters with things like this!

records.jp: アホくさ
records.en_original: This is pointless...
records.en_auxiliary: This is pointless...
records.en: This is pointless...

records.jp: わたしは良いと思うな。<CR>ねえ、愛央ちゃんなら何て名前を付ける？
records.en_original: I think it's a good idea. What would you name it, Ao?
records.en_auxiliary: I think it's a good idea. What would you name it, Ao?
records.en: I think it's a good idea.<CR>Ao-chan, what would you call them?

records.jp: そうだなあ……
records.en_original: Um, let's see...
records.en_auxiliary: Um, let's see...
records.en: Um, let's see...

records.jp: ……ココロトープ、はどうかな？<CR>心のビオトープで、ココロトープ
records.en_original: How about "Heartscape"? Since it's a land made from people's hearts.
records.en_auxiliary: How about "Heartscape"? Since it's a land made from people's hearts.
records.en: How about... 'Heartscapes'?<CR>Biotopes of the heart: Heartscapes.

records.jp: ちょっと、それ私が言ったやつ！<CR>巻き込まないでよ
records.en_original: Wait, that's what I said earlier! Don't involve me in this!
records.en_auxiliary: Wait, that's what I said earlier! Don't involve me in this!
records.en: Hey, that's based on what I said!<CR>Don't drag me into this.

records.jp: えー、いいじゃん、なんかおしゃれで
records.en_original: Hey, I think it sounds pretty!
records.en_auxiliary: Hey, I think it sounds pretty!
records.en: Hey, I think it sounds pretty!

records.jp: あたしも良いと思う！
records.en_original: Me too! That's a cool name!
records.en_auxiliary: Me too! That's a cool name!
records.en: I think it's good too!

records.jp: じゃあ、ココロトープで決まりだね
records.en_original: Then we'll go with Heartscape.
records.en_auxiliary: Then we'll go with Heartscape.
records.en: Then 'Heartscape' it is.

records.jp: 解せない……
records.en_original: Ignored...
records.en_auxiliary: Ignored...
records.en: I don't get it...

records.jp: まあまあ。そのくらいにして今日のところは休も！<CR>いっぱい歩き回って疲れちゃったよ、あたし
records.en_original: Well, I, for one, think we should turn in for the day! I'm bushed after all that walking.
records.en_auxiliary: Well, I, for one, think we should turn in for the day! I'm bushed after all that walking.
records.en: Come on, that's enough for today. Let's rest!<CR>I'm exhausted from all that walking.

records.jp: ……それもそうだね。<CR>時間はたっぷりあるだろうし
records.en_original: Yeah, I agree. We've got nothing but time, after all.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, I agree. We've got nothing but time, after all.
records.en: ...Yeah, that's true.<CR>We should have plenty of time.

records.jp: 教室に戻って休もうか
records.en_original: Let's go back to the classroom and rest.
records.en_auxiliary: Let's go back to the classroom and rest.
records.en: Let's go back to the classroom and rest.

records.jp: <CLGR>こころ<CLNR>のタレントに<CR>新たなタレントタイプが解放されました
records.en_original: A new Talent Type has been unlocked in <CLGR>Kokoro's<CLNR> Talents.
records.en_auxiliary: A new Talent Type has been unlocked in <CLGR>Kokoro's<CLNR> Talents.
records.en: A new Talent Type has<CR>been unlocked in <CLGR>Kokoro's<CLNR> Talents.
